# R385 — Conversion-first acceptance, verified-offer gate and creator handoff
**DRAFT ONLY · 2026-11-14 · owner Mind & Perception editorial/presell, not Grok/Dispatch/engineering.**
**References:** Mind #171, business charter #818, attribution #820, Dispatch #174, Site QA #126, homepage #150 / PR #49, canonical Mind hub PR #172. Do not edit or merge any owner's work.

## 0. Executive commercial decision: no verified transaction path

**Zen12 Premium remains the high-intent candidate, not an eligible live FV offer.** We inspected the official Inspire3 catalogue, exact Zen12 offer, the public partner network and related Hypnosis Live and Brainwave Shots public seller websites on 2026-11-14. The seller publicly describes 12 levels, 48 MP3s, guides, support, bonuses and a one-year refund promise, displaying $87.99 for Premium at the public tier; that is not authenticated referred checkout pricing, proof of delivered goods, proof that refunds are honored, or evidence for cognition/health benefits. The affiliate portal's published headline terms are marketing—not proof of Final Vestige account acceptance, assigned commissions or channel permissions. A focused Gmail search returned consumer/promotional messages, not dependable partner-approval evidence. We did **not** claim the network has denied FV.

**Fallback commercial path:** No verifiably purchasable, rights-cleared FV-owned Mind SKU or attributable Payhip transaction was authenticated through the available public material and connected mailbox. The free 52-page Focus Fieldbook is not a paid product. Creating a fake or hypothetical checkout to show activity would violate the revenue-first directive. Hold both routes until Commerce supplies an actual SKU, contract and lawful checkout/test evidence. The best immediate customer-serving action is a free research guide and the already-approved single Jetpack Focus funnel.

**No outbound merchant link, affiliate tracking, product activation, paid ad, email blast, navigation or CMS write.**

## 1. One intent/offer decision instead of another generic storefront

**Primary audience:** Someone who already wants a short, prestructured meditation listening routine but is skeptical of unsupported brainwave and health promises. They may have reached FV after a credible perception video; the relevant purchase motivation is guided convenience, downloadable files, instruction and a clear refund process—not treatment of a condition. **Offer:** the exact Zen12 **Premium** tier, after named acceptance. Do not interchange with Beginner, Advanced, Hypnosis Live singles or Brainwave Shots.

**Original presell proposition:** 'Before You Pay for Meditation Audio, Separate the Format from the Promise.' The source-backed micro-story is the Thatcher illusion; the practical gift is a free twelve-minute routine to discover whether the visitor values a guided audio format. This establishes relevance without pretending a visual illusion substantiates music or meditation outcomes.

**Commercial CTA:** disabled native button labeled 'Purchasing unavailable — verification required.' Once and only once all approval and release gates pass, Claude may propose converting this to an ordinary accessible off-site link using the exact partner-issued URL and allowed rel attributes. Preserve the adjacent readable statement: 'If you purchase through this link, Final Vestige may earn a commission at no additional cost to you.' Do not disguise the link behind redirects, invented discount codes or unclear button labels.

**Contextual buyer alternatives:** the live Focus Fieldbook (existing single signup), or simply use the free exercise without signing up. Nothing on the research article or product guide requires email to read.

## 3. A/B: useful text guide vs identical text + optional film

**A:** Accessible static text-only buyer guide with research, the exercise, stated seller package features, limitations, objections, one verified free alternative, inactive commerce CTA and proximate disclosure.

**B:** The *same substantive buyer text* plus an original 42-second narrated-film storyboard with original SVG poster, complete six-cue WebVTT file and accessible transcript available without JS. The current B page is **not playable video** and cannot be called a completed media test. Before a paid outcome test, encode original rights-cleared video, provide captions and transcript, no autoplay, controls visible, preload='none', lazy poster, no cross-origin embeds or heavy libraries. Avoid 'watch to unlock', popups and motion forced on reduced-motion visitors. Text A and B remain usable without JS, and B video is wholly optional.

**Primary experimental outcome:** realized net revenue per 1,000 qualified-human sessions for a verified, exactly defined 7-day and 30-day landing cohort. Net = independently settled paid FV orders/merchant-confirmed affiliate commissions - reconciled refunds - platform/payment fees attributable to those orders. No traffic-only conversion substitutes. **Secondary:** independently confirmed paid orders per qualified session; verified Focus signup (only if provider confirms); actual merchant-reported paid affiliate conversions; CTA/outbound interactions (diagnostic, not purchase). **Safeguards:** first-party page performance, mobile bounce, substantive reading, accessibility, trust/disclosure complaints.

**Allocation proposal to Claude:** if the platform/consent policy allows, randomly split eligible first-party qualified sessions 50/50 at the server or existing approved experiment layer, recording only group assignment and a non-PII cohort key for short 7/30-day aggregation. Do not install a second tracker, fingerprint visitors or require a sign-in. Define 'qualified human session' with existing bot/internal-traffic exclusions and a published rule, not just UA guessing. Keep the same creator asset/hook/landing intent across variants. Never compare two different Grok videos as if copy/video were the only factor. If stable allocation cannot be done with existing consent and privacy constraints, report that an unbiased A/B is **blocked** and do a controlled internal usability comparison instead. No covert cookie or browser fingerprint.

**Decision rules:** first pass all safety/rights/checkout/data gates. Then monitor actual paid-conversion and revenue cohorts. Tiny samples remain exploratory; report number of sessions, confirmed orders, point estimates and uncertainty before declaring a winner. Zero sales with zero/unknown denominator is *not* 0% conversion. Mark net revenue/1,000 'NOT COMPUTABLE' until both numerator and qualified denominator are independently verified.

## 4. Attribution/measurement contract — no duplicated scripts

| event | definition | evidence standard | NOT the same as |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| qualified_landing | consent-safe, de-botted first-party visit to exact published article/guide with valid campaign attribution | existing approved first-party event/aggregate and Grok asset_id mapping | pageview count or presumed human |
| article_to_focus_click | user-initiated click on current /focus/ link | existing permitted first-party CTA event | signup or purchase |
| confirmed_focus_lead | provider-verified confirmed subscriber in existing Jetpack list, if linkable with appropriate consent | provider confirmation plus consent-safe aggregate join; else unattributed | form submission/unconfirmed account |
| offer_cta_click | user-initiated *authorized* click to an eligible merchant URL | permitted event with campaign ID; disabled pilot has no merchant click | checkout start, commission |
| affiliate_outbound | actual approved merchant referral navigation, if partner terms permit measurement | event + consent with URL integrity | affiliate conversion |
| merchant_confirmed_purchase | actual settled merchant order or independently reported paid affiliate conversion | vendor transaction/commission ledger; exclude unpaid/refunded | outbound/cookie |
| realized_net_revenue | paid settled amount less fees/refunds, restricted to reliably attributed cohort | verifiable merchant/processor reports + reconciliation | advertised headline EPC or clicks |

**UTM scheme:** utm_source={youtube|tiktok|instagram|facebook}, utm_medium=organic_social, utm_campaign=mind_perception_pilot_2026_11, utm_content={grok_verified_asset_id}. Use existing source/platform URLs and legal linking patterns, not invented bio-link shortcuts. On downstream pages preserve attribution only where permitted and only with approved first-party analytics. Do not append private identifiers, email addresses, order information, or individual visitor tokens to URLs. Merchant-provided attribution keys may be used only if contractually authorized, disclosed and compliant with privacy rules. Never infer a paid commission from a UTM.

**Scorecard (7- and 30-day):** cohort date; actual verified asset_id; topic; qualified-human sessions; eligible CTA clicks; confirmed leads; referred checkouts *only if independently observable*; merchant-confirmed orders and refunded orders; gross cash received; program fees; attributable commission; realized net dollars; net/1,000 qualified sessions; data confidence; unresolved attribution percentage; source receipts; owner; decision. Hide individual contact information and never merge platform identities.

## 6. Security, editorial and QA acceptance

1. Check raw seller/product language against exact current official offer at release, not merely the general Inspire3 category page; do not copy ad swipe.
2. Commercial claim matrix statuses remain explicit: 'seller-described' isn't 'experimentally proven'; no hidden health or wealth implication.
3. No active merchant href, checkout embed, tracking pixel, new form, countdown, autoplay, script, frame or forced third-party requests in draft.
4. Near-offer disclosure reads before/adjacent to CTA with keyboard and screen reader. A general footer disclosure is not sufficient.
5. Real-browser responsive QA at 360, 390, 768, 1440 and 1920px, zoom at 200/400%, keyboard, no-JS, reduced motion, screen reader and contrast. Static validators are useful but not a substitute.
6. Rights: independent first-party poster does not reuse Thompson/Margaret Thatcher image or seller assets. Do not publish photograph without licensed record.
7. Check encoded video file budget, lazy loading, captions, full transcript and no autoplay after production.
8. Recheck all internal article links; the new Thatcher article and /mind/ are not live, so do not place a link to either in existing site navigation.
9. Keep PR #49, Issue #150, PR #172, canonical Jetpack welcome and Issue #174 newsletter content unchanged.
10. Obtain explicit founder commercial publication authorization, an approved analytics implementation from Claude, and independent Site QA review *before* live activation.

**Evidence boundary:** GitHub source commits establish BUILT; an isolated V8 checker establishes only the tested static invariants. They cannot establish actual WCAG, actual revenue, working checkout, privacy compliance in production, validated lead, or film playback. Dates refer to November 14, 2026 source readings; all price and seller terms must be rechecked before permitted release.
